title: Janet Fielding oral history September 2016

lds05: Janet Fielding (born Janet Claire Mahoney, 9 September 1953) is an Australian actress, known for her role in the BBC science fiction television series Doctor Who as companion Tegan Jovanka. Born in Brisbane, Fielding made her UK TV debut in 1980. From 1981 to 1984 she portrayed the part of Tegan Jovanka, offsider to Tom Baker's fourth Doctor Who and later Peter Davison, the fifth Doctor. Fielding continued acting until 1991. in the mid 2000s she revised the role of Tegan for a number of Doctor Who radio plays. In addition to acting, she has worked as a theatrical agent and for a number of charities. Janet Fielding currently resides in the UK.
